name: qol-skills
description: Claude Code skills for the qol-tools ecosystem (qol-tray host app, plugins, shared libs, CI workflows, and general engineering practices) — split into fine-grained plugins for per-plugin toggling.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-alt-tab
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray alt-tab plugin: GPUI window list, X11/macOS preview capture, daemon lifecycle, settings UI, and release flow.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-launcher
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray launcher plugin: GPUI launcher architecture, discovery/ranking, and release flow.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-pointz
plugins.description: Skills for the PointZ pair: qol-tray desktop server plugin and the Flutter mobile client (discovery, UDP transport, input injection).

plugins.name: qol-plugin-ide-checkout
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray ide-checkout (Task Runner) plugin: Rust supervisor + Python daemon internals and the task-runner HTTP API contract.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-keyremap
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray key remap plugin (macOS only): CGEventTap daemon, rule kinds, per-app exclusions, and rule editor UI.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-lights
plugins.description: Specialist agent and skills for the qol-tray lights plugin: backend adapters (Zigbee2MQTT first), ZNP serial stack, daemon/runtime split, auto-config settings UI, and a SubagentStop hook that auto-curates agent MEMORY.md.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-os-themes
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray OS themes plugin: shake-to-grow cursor effect, X11 cursor manipulation via xfixes, and the broader theming roadmap.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-screen-recorder
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray screen recorder plugin: ffmpeg recording flow and X11-based display capture.

plugins.name: qol-plugin-window-actions
plugins.description: Skills for the qol-tray window actions plugin: window minimize/restore and monitor movement.

plugins.name: qol-tray
plugins.description: Host-app plugin for qol-tray: specialist agents (frontend, backend) plus deep skills for core architecture (qol-tray-core), Rust internals, UI systems, dev logging, world canvas, Profile feature, release flow, and apps-testing. Includes hooks for routing edits to the right specialist agent and reflecting agent learnings.

plugins.name: qol-workflow
plugins.description: Cross-cutting workflow conventions for any qol-tools repo: commit message conventions (with the no-attribution hard rule), git push and worktree workflows, and universal coding guidelines. Includes a PreToolUse(Bash) hook that injects commit context and blocks AI-attribution lines.

plugins.name: qol-langs
plugins.description: Personal-experience wells for languages and frameworks used in qol-tools: rust-conventions, gpui-conventions, preact-conventions. Workspace-specific style and gotchas, NOT canonical library docs — for those, use context7.

plugins.name: qol-project
plugins.description: Project-level conventions for the qol-tools ecosystem: the qol-mission (non-negotiable user-facing promises), qol-tools (org layout, dependency model), qol-cicd (shared workflows), qol-arch-code (cross-platform code strategy pattern), qol-arch-cross-platform (symbol/import hygiene that prevents dead_code-on-other-platform under -D warnings), qol-arch-cicd (CI/release workflow contract that enforces matrix builds and path-dep parity), qol-shared-libs, qol-plugin-template. Ships three PreToolUse hooks (one per arch skill) that block edits violating each contract.
